title: Uniform Hⁿ-measure of open balls in n-planes (parent step 1)
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ. There is a real number ω > 0, depending only on n, with the following property. For every N ∈ ℕ, every linear subspace T of ℝᴺ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) with dim T = n, every w ∈ T and every ρ > 0: Hⁿ(T ∩ B(w, ρ)) = ofReal(ω ρⁿ). Here Hⁿ = μHE[n] (Euclidean Hausdorff measure, applied to arbitrary sets as an outer measure), B(w, ρ) is the open ball and ofReal = ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ ω : ℝ, 0 < ω ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (T : Submodule ℝ (Rn N)), finrank ℝ T = n → ∀ w ∈ T, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μHE[n] ((T : Set (Rn N)) ∩ Metric.ball w ρ) = ENNReal.ofReal (ω * ρ ^ n)
